scope: Make transient Editor diagnostics safe to inspect and copy while retaining the current draft after failed saves.

implementation.stable_codes: Diagnostic codes are based on source and severity; random entry IDs distinguish occurrences without changing the code taxonomy.
implementation.redaction: Messages, file locations, and context are normalized and length-bounded. Query values, bearer/auth values, common secret fields, email addresses, and phone-like values are redacted; file paths omit parent directories; raw Error objects and stacks are not retained.
implementation.api_deduplication: HTTP response errors are marked at their source so one failed request is not added a second time as a transport error.
implementation.buffer: Diagnostic history stays transient, capped at 100 entries, and is not a Page Model or persisted draft field.
implementation.recovery: Failed Save leaves the edited field and canvas draft intact; the user can retry; the retry remains Save and does not Publish.
